sections.heading: Understanding Curtain Wall Systems and Why Repairs Matter
sections.body: Glass curtain walls are non-structural cladding systems that form the exterior skin of commercial buildings. They are designed to bear their own weight while resisting wind loads, thermal movement, and weather exposure — all without transferring those forces to the building's primary structure. When components degrade, the consequences extend well beyond aesthetics. Failing gaskets and sealants allow water to penetrate behind the glazing, damaging interior finishes, insulation, and structural elements. Cracked or broken glass panels create safety hazards and compromise the thermal performance of the entire facade. Corroded or damaged framing members can cause panels to shift or become unstable. Addressing curtain wall issues promptly limits the scope of damage and the cost of remediation. Our Alexandria commercial glazing team has the equipment, trained technicians, and material expertise to assess the full extent of deterioration and execute repairs that restore the system to sound working condition.

sections.heading: Common Curtain Wall Problems We Repair in Alexandria
sections.body: Commercial properties throughout Alexandria — from the dense office developments near the Eisenhower Avenue Metro corridor to mixed-use buildings in the historic Torpedo Factory district — experience a predictable range of curtain wall issues over time. We routinely address broken or cracked glass panels caused by impact, thermal stress, or settlement. Sealant and gasket failure is one of the most common problems we encounter; aged or improperly installed sealants allow moisture and air to infiltrate, undermining energy performance and interior comfort. Condensation forming between double- or triple-pane insulated glass units signals seal failure and requires unit replacement. Aluminum framing components can develop corrosion, fatigue cracks, or misalignment that prevents panels from seating correctly. We also handle anchor and fastener failures, deteriorated pressure caps, and damaged structural silicone adhesive joints. Each repair is approached with a full assessment first so that nothing is patched over without understanding the root cause.

sections.heading: Our Curtain Wall Repair Process for Alexandria Commercial Properties
sections.body: Every curtain wall repair engagement begins with a thorough site inspection. Our technicians examine the affected areas from both interior and exterior vantage points, using lifts or rigging as needed to access upper floors safely. We document the condition of glazing, framing, sealants, and drainage components before recommending a scope of work. Once a repair plan is agreed upon, we source replacement glass panels, gaskets, framing components, and sealants that are compatible with the existing system. Our crew works efficiently to minimize any disruption to tenants or building operations — a priority for occupied office towers, multifamily properties, and retail buildings alike. After completing repairs, we test affected areas for water tightness and review the work with the property manager or general contractor. We maintain clear communication throughout the project and leave the site clean and secure at every stage.

faq.q: How do I know if my Alexandria commercial building needs curtain wall repair or full replacement?
faq.a: In many cases, targeted repair is the most cost-effective solution. Isolated panel cracks, localized sealant failure, or a limited number of fogged insulated glass units can typically be addressed through repair without replacing the entire system. A professional inspection is the best starting point — our team will assess the full extent of deterioration and give you an honest recommendation based on what we find.

faq.q: How long does a curtain wall repair take for a typical commercial building?
faq.a: Repair timelines depend on the scope of the problem, the number of panels or components affected, and access requirements. Minor repairs involving a few panels or sealant joints can often be completed in one to two days. Larger projects involving multiple floors or extensive sealant replacement may take longer and will be scheduled to minimize disruption to building occupants. We provide a clear timeline estimate before work begins.

faq.q: Can you match the existing glass in my Alexandria office building's curtain wall?
faq.a: We work to source replacement glass that matches the existing system as closely as possible in terms of tint, coating, thickness, and performance characteristics. For older buildings, finding an exact match can sometimes be challenging, but our team has extensive supplier relationships and experience sourcing compatible glazing products. We will communicate any constraints and present options before ordering materials.
